grh_19f2f7fd05eb008dc94e.title: A Night in a Harem
paragraphs: Harry decides millionaire oilman Sam Cord is the perfect mark and gets drawn into a supposed oil concession in a tiny Red Sea kingdom. Princess Laila, a supposed geologist and competing interests make Harry believe he can earn ten percent of a $100 million deal, while palace intrigue sends him through disguises, threats and a six-hour wait in the royal harem. He finally learns he was being used to drive up the option price: the alleged oil expert was an actor and there was no oil. His grand commission disappears, leaving Harry to admit that this time the sucker was himself.

grh_19ab6f8a8bef5a5fd5cd.title: The Case Of Tommy Holms
paragraphs: After attorney Gerald Fox deliberately crashes his car, he claims total amnesia just hours before a deadline for locating young Tommy Holmes, heir to a million-dollar estate. Dr. Christian becomes suspicious when Fox conveniently cannot identify the boy and discovers that Fox and the late mans business partner would profit if the heir is not confirmed in time. grh_19a9b7f4154adcb4c4c9.title: Rogues Regiment
paragraphs: American intelligence agent Whit Corbett enters the French Foreign Legion in Indochina to identify Nazi war criminal Martin Bruner, whose face and identity have disappeared among thousands of former soldiers. Working with French agent Lili and Colonel Mauclaire, Corbett follows a trail of gunrunning, forged papers and hidden money. Dying Legionnaire Heinrich finally reveals that the man called Riker is Bruner. Corbett tracks him to Saigon, where Bruner tries to escape with a forged passport, a fortune hidden in platinum tools and Lili as a hostage. Corbett overpowers him and brings him back alive; the story closes with Bruner executed for his war crimes.
